bullets.text: moved the desk to where the draft actually lands. letting the fan argue with july on my behalf.
duck sat still at motoyama-ji, temple seventy. today's line did the walking: something about magnetism changing a life. 🌿
cicadas arrived overnight. the whole hillside changed its mind about silence.
quiet week in the chest. suspicious of it, keeping it anyway.
the magnet doesn't pull. the iron remembers.
